description: Dr. Max Burchett, Jr. is a pharmacist, healthcare executive, and CIO of the largest Urban Native American Clinic in the USA. A Bartlesville native who has called Guthrie home since 2021, he is running for Oklahoma House District 33 to bring practical, results-driven leadership to state government.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Burchett For House 2026
title: Meet Dr. Max Burchett, Jr. — Practical Leadership for District 33
